tasks.analysis: Extinctions are a natural part of Earth's history. They can result from a variety of causes, such as climate change, habitat loss, and competition with other species. Among the most famous extinction events was the disappearance of nearly all of the dinosaurs 65 million years ago. Today, human activities are accelerating the rate of extinctions, posing a significant threat to biodiversity. Conservation efforts aim to protect endangered species and preserve the natural ecosystems they depend on. 物种灭绝是地球历史的自然组成部分。其成因多种多样，包括气候变化、栖息地丧失以及与其他物种的生存竞争。6500 万年前几乎所有恐龙的消亡，就是最著名的灭绝事件之一。如今，人类活动正在加快物种灭绝的速度，对生物多样性构成严重威胁。各类保护行动旨在守护濒危物种，维系它们赖以生存的自然生态系统。
